name: Turkish standards cited in specifications (TSE)
review_status: Drawn from public sources and not read against the standards themselves, which are sold documents. Reference only. Pending review by a Turkish engineer of each discipline.
scope_note: The standards named here are structural and building-fabric ones. The standards an installation contractor is held to are cited item by item in the Ministry unit-price book and in the general technical specifications, see tesisat_teknik_sartnameleri.
description: What a specification clause or a bill line in Türkiye is checked for against the standards of the Türk Standardları Enstitüsü (TSE): that the clause cites the applicable TS or TS EN standard, that the cited edition is current, and that a material grade is one the standard defines. The ids below name the standards the checks were planned around: TS EN 206 for concrete, TS 500 for reinforced concrete design, TS 648 for steel structures, TS 825 for thermal insulation and the Eurocodes with their national annexes.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
